import math, csv, io

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',','\n','\r','"']):
        return '"'+s+'"'
    return s

# Build unique song details
unique_song_ids = sorted(list(song_ids))
print('exporting', len(unique_song_ids), 'unique songs')

rows=[]
for idx, sid in enumerate(unique_song_ids):
    # fetch details
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=int(sid))
    title = song.get('title','')
    artists = song.get('artists',[])
    artist_names = [a.get('name','') for a in artists if a.get('name') is not None]
    artists_field = '|'.join(artist_names)
    rows.append((title, artists_field))
    if idx < 3 or idx == len(unique_song_ids)-1:
        print('sample', idx, sid, title, artists_field)

# Compose CSV content
lines=[]
lines.append('Title,Artists')
for title, artists_field in rows:
    lines.append(csv_escape(title)+','+csv_escape(artists_field))
content='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
print('content_length', len(content))
print('first_lines:\n', '\n'.join(lines[:5]))
